about: Weekly re-check of OnCo against public sources (scripts/weekly-recheck.ts). Each finding: the record, what OnCo says, what the source says, the source URL and the source's date. Findings are not applied to records.

checks.label: Trial registry drift
mechanical: src/data/trial-registry-status.ts regenerated by scripts/fetch-registry-status.ts from this run's reading: 253 status changes recorded (242 before). Result statuses and the historic label are kept by that script's rules. 11 further changes were held back because the record's own sentences would contradict the new status; they are listed below.
src/data/trial-participation.ts refreshed by scripts/refresh-trial-participation.ts --stale-updated: 140 studies re-read (25 with a changed status), 0 entries detached, in 63 further requests.
notes: 6,411 registrations read for 6,524 trial records; 1 not returned. Registry statuses today: recruiting 3007, active not recruiting 1503, completed 921, not yet recruiting 552, unknown 207, terminated 170, enrolling by invitation 22, withdrawn 17, suspended 6, approved for marketing 4, no longer available 1.

A status is corrected by the generators (see "Changed by the run itself"). The text of a record is not: where a row quotes words such as "recruiting" or "awaited", the record still says them. Differences of enrolment, sponsor and primary completion date on records written by the registry ingest are differences in the record's own sentences, which no generator rewrites.

checks.label: Dead links (a quarter of the corpus each week)

Only 404, 410 and a PDF address that serves a web page are listed. A refusal (401, 403, 429, a bot-challenge page) is counted as blocked and never as dead. A DOI is checked at doi.org and not followed to the publisher.
